Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. The Netherlands players are out in the middle. Shamarh Brooks and Shai Hope are the openers for West Indies! Ryan Klein to start with the ball.
...The Chase...

Right then! West Indies have a serious chance to seal the series as the score is well under their control and they would have taken it any day. The Dutch bowlers showed good signs in the first match but they have to bowl out of their skins to test the Men in Maroon here. Stay tuned as the chase is coming up shortly.

West Indies started brightly and got ample opportunities but didn't grab them. They lost the plot after that but once the spinners were included in the attack, things started to tilt the visitors' way as wickets started falling and runs were hard to buy. 6 wickets went to spinners' way as they ran riot through the Netherlands batting line up. Akeal Hosein ended with four while Alzarri Joseph was impressive as well. He ended with a brace. Nicholas Pooran will be happy that their fielding got better after dropping some early catches.

Apart from the top three, no one from the Dutch side managed to get a double-digit score. Netherlands will be disappointed with their batting. The openers were given life early on and took the opportunity with both hands and gave a perfect start and were looking well on course for a big total. Singh fell short of his fifty but his crime-partner Max O'Dowd did reach his fifty. Both perished in a short span but after giving a good start. Scott Edwards looked good but he had no one on the other side to bond with. He brought his fifty but at a crawling pace and Netherlands have finished well below the par score here.

A fantastic bowling performance from West Indies. Netherlands were 101/1 at one moment and looked all set for a big total but an incredible downfall sees them getting bundled out without playing the full quota. A fact for all, the last boundary in this innings came in the 31st over. That just tells how impressive West Indies were.

OUT! CAUGHT! Scott Edwards holes out and Netherlands have been bowled out for 214! A slower full delivery on off. The ball is in the slot for Scott Edwards to go big and he looks to slog-sweep it. However, he gets the elevation but not the distance required. Kyle Mayers at deep mid-wicket settles under it and takes the catch. Good innings from Scott Edwards but they needed someone to support him.
Commentary.Howout: c Kyle Mayers b Anderson Phillip

Commentary.Commentary: On a length, on off. Shariz Ahmad dabs it towards point and takes a quick single.
A fullish delivery, around off. Scott Edwards gets across and looks to heave it towards the leg side. He misses and the ball hits his pads and goes towards the off side. A leg bye taken.
Shariz Ahmad is the last man in.

OUT! BOWLED! Alzarri Joseph gets his second wicket and Netherlands are nine down now! Joseph lands it on a length, on off. Ryan Klein looks to defend but misses and the ball shatters the off pole. Netherlands are in danger of falling short of a par total here.
A fuller delivery on off. Ryan Klein defends it towards mid on.
Back of a length, on middle. Scott Edwards works it towards backward square leg for a single.
Ryan Klein walks to the middle.

OUT! RUN OUT! Aryan Dutt has to walk back in a bid to steal a bye! A short ball, around off.Dutt looks to guide it towards the off side but misses. The ball goes off the bounce to Hope behind the stumps. Scott Edwards calls Dutt for a bye and Dutt reacts but does it a bit late. Hope collects the ball and throws it towards the bowler. Alzarri Joseph collects the ball and whips the bails off as Dutt is short of his crease.
Another single! A full delivery on off. Scott Edwards drives it to long on for a single.
Back of a length, around off. Dutt forces it down to long on for a single.
A low full toss on off. Dutt pushes it to long on for a single.
A short delivery on off. Dutt looks to pull but ends up playing it early and the ball goes off the cue end of his blade towards backward point.
A fuller delivery on middle. Scott Edwards gets across and looks to scoop it but ends up getting a toe-end of his blade. The ball rolls towards short mid-wicket for a single.
On a length, on off. Aryan Dutt defends it towards the off side for a single.
A full delivery on off. Scott Edwards drives it to long off for a single.
A fullish slower delivery, around off. Scott Edwards drives it to covers.
Back of a length, around off. Scott Edwards steers it towards third man for a single.
Aryan Dutt comes in.

OUT! CAUGHT! This is brilliant death bowling by Alzarri Joseph and he completely outfoxes the batter! A slower length ball, around off. Logan van Beek looks to heave it across the line but is early on the shot and ends up getting the bottom of his blade. The ball goes straight up in the air towards right of mid-wicket. The substitute fielder Shermon Lewis moves to his right and takes the catch easily.
Commentary.Howout: c sub Shermon Lewis b Alzarri Joseph

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length, on middle. Scott Edwards works it towards deep backward square leg for a single.
A yorker on off at 143 kph. Logan van Beek manages to dig it out towards the off side for a single.
A fuller delivery on middle. Scott Edwards works it to deep square leg for a single.
Short delivery and around leg. Scott Edwards looks to hook it away but misses.
200 up for Netherlands! Very full and on middle. Logan van Beek tucks it wide of long on and collects a couple.
Shorter and on middle, pulled away to deep square leg for a single.
Hits the hard length and removes the pace. Logan van Beek pulls it softly to mid-wicket for a single.
Another single as Scott Edwards nudges it to square leg.
On middle, on a length. Logan van Beek steps across and tucks it to square leg for a single.
On a length and just around off. Scott Edwards works it off his splice to short third man for a single.
Too full and on middle. Scott Edwards whips it to fine leg and keeps the strike.
Anderson Phillip (5-0-21-0) is back into the attack.
On middle, fuller, drilled down to long on for a single.
Length and outside off. Scott Edwards works it to third man for a single.

Dropped! Bangs a bouncer, angling on leg. Logan van Beek looks to pull as he gets across but removes his eyes and the top edge goes to the left of the keeper, Shai Hope stretches to his left and gets a glove on it but only gets some part out of it. A single.
Tad fuller and on off. Logan van Beek defends it out.
Length and on middle. Scott Edwards shows his leg stump and tickles it to fine leg for one.
Alzarri Joseph (5-1-18-0) is back into the attack.
Fuller and outside off, pushed to mid off. Akeal Hosein ends his excellent spell here, four wickets for him.
Drops it short and on middle. Scott Edwards pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On middle. Blocked out on the front foot.
Tossed up on middle. Scott Edwards tries to play on the leg side but gets a leading edge to covers.
Pushes it quicker and on middle. Scott Edwards paddles it but finds short fine leg.
Too full and on middle, Logan van Beek sweeps it to fine leg for a single.
Tossed up, outside off. Scott Edwards drives it to deep cover for a couple of runs.
On middle, pulled away to deep square leg for one.
Similar to the previous ball but this time Logan van Beek tries to drive it and gets beaten on the inside edge. Was a googly and Logan van Beek failed to read it.
Outside off. Left alone.
Flatter and outside off. Scott Edwards punches it through covers for a single.
Full and on off. Scott Edwards steps across and flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a brace. It brings up his fifty as well. A fine innings from Edwards. It includes just one boundary!
Change of ends for Hayden Walsh.
Fuller and outside off. Scott Edwards drags it to deep square leg for a single.
Logan van Beek is the next man in.

OUT! TAKEN! The spinners continue to do the job for West Indies as another one bites the dust! An arm ball, flatter and going across to Seelaar. He tries to slog-sweep it but gets only elevation on it. Kyle Mayers at deep square leg runs forward and holds onto it.
Commentary.Howout: c Kyle Mayers b Akeal Hosein

Commentary.Commentary: An arm ball, quicker and on off. Pieter Seelaar tries to go downtown but splices it over backward point for a couple.
On middle. Blocked back to the bowler.
Flatter and around off. Scott Edwards plays the reverse sweep to short third man and calls for a quick single. Pieter Seelaar has to hurry there but makes his ground on time.
Fuller and on middle. Scott Edwards laps it over to fine leg for a couple of runs.
End of Powerplay 2! The final phase will see 5 fielders allowed outside the 30-yard circle. Akeal Hosein is back into the attack.
Short and wide outside off. Scott Edwards cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.

Tossed up on off. Scott Edwards pushes it towards the off side and sets off for a single. However, he is sent back and King who comes charging in fires a direct hit at the batter's end. Scott Edwards dives to get back. The leg umpire takes it upstairs and the replays show that Scott Edwards makes his ground with that good dive.
Loopy delivery, around off. Pieter Seelaar looks to sweep it but misses. The ball brushes his pads and goes towards short third man for a single.
Short and around middle leg. Pieter Seelaar makes room and looks to pull it but gets the inside edge onto his pads. He will be disappointed on missing out on this one.
NO BALL! Bonner has overstepped here! Loopy delivery on off. Scott Edwards drives it to mid off and takes a quick single this time. Free Hit coming up.
Tossed up, around off. Scott Edwards drives it to mid off.
A fuller delivery on off. Scott Edwards sweeps it towards deep backward square leg for a couple.

Lovely googly by Walsh! This is pitched around off. Pieter Seelaar comes forward to defend it but the ball turns in and sneaks through the gap between his bat and pad. Luckily for Pieter Seelaar it just misses the off pole.
Pushed quicker and around off. Scott Edwards drives it towards covers and takes a quick single.
Quicker and fuller on off. Scott Edwards drives it back to the bowler.
A half-tracker on middle. Pieter Seelaar pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Flatter and shorter on middle. Scott Edwards works it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Fuller and quicker on middle. Scott Edwards works it to short mid-wicket.
Flighted one again, on off. Pieter Seelaar drives it again back to the bowler.
Loopy delivery on off. Pieter Seelaar drives it back to the bowler.
Short and wide outside off. Scott Edwards cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
This is pitched on middle and turns away a bit. Pieter Seelaar goes back and pushes it to long on for a single.
A low full toss on off. Scott Edwards drives it to long on for a single.
A flatter delivery on middle. Scott Edwards works it towards backward square leg and looks for a single but is sent back.
Angling on the pads. Scott Edwards nudges it towards the leg side and retains the strike with a single.
An arm ball on off. Scott Edwards blocks it out.
Darted on middle. Scott Edwards sweeps it towards deep backward square leg for a couple.
A fuller delivery on off. Pieter Seelaar drives it to long off for a single.
Pieter Seelaar walks out now.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Akeal Hosein comes back into the attack and strikes! This is a loopy delivery on middle. Teja Nidamanuru looks to drive it but is a tad early on his shot. Maybe the ball just holds on the surface. He ends up hitting in the air and straight to Akeal Hosein. He takes a sharp return catch and Netherlands are in trouble here.
Darted on middle. Scott Edwards works it towards mid-wicket for a single.
On off and full again. Teja Nidamanuru drives it to covers.
Pushed quicker on off. Scott Edwards drives it to short cover. The fielder there half-stops it and the batters run a single as the fielder collects the ball and has a shy at the batter's end.
This is outside off and slower in the air again, Teja Nidamanuru drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Flighted delivery on off. Teja Nidamanuru pushes it back to the bowler.
Fuller on off. Scott Edwards drives it to the cover fielder in the ring and takes a single.
Tossed up, outside off. Teja Nidamanuru drives it to deep extra-cover for a single.

Another appeal and another review is taken! Looks like the impact is outside off again! Yup, the replay confirms it. West Indies burn all their review. This is a googly, fuller and outside off. Scott Edwards steps forward and across to block it but misses and gets rapped on the pads. Scott Edwards survives again!

Two leg byes! Tossed up, length and outside off. Scott Edwards shuffles across and looks to paddle it but misses and gets hit on the pads. It rolls behind square on the leg side. A huge appeal for LBW but not given and West Indies take the review. UltraEdge shows no bat there while Ball Tracking shows the impact is outside off. Two runs taken.
Floats up, on off, Scott Edwards strokes it to cover.
Too full and around off. Scott Edwards again drives but finds the fielder at mid off.
A single as Nidamanuru drives this full ball to long off.
Flatter and outside off. Nidamanuru chops it to first slip who collects it on a bounce.
A loopy ball, on off. Scott Edwards skips down and drives it to long off. The player from long on comes across and does the sweeping work. Two runs taken.
Around off, eased down to long off for a single.
Fuller and outside off, driven to covers.
Tossed up, on off. Blocked out.
Teja Nidamanuru walks in at number 6.

OUT! TAKEN! Superb catch by Akeal Hosein! Bonner serves a low dipping full toss, outside off. Ahmad pre-meditates his reverse sweep and hits it uppishly and towards backward point where Akeal Hosein dives to his right and the ball sticks nicely in his palms. West Indies are dropping sitters but taking some stunners. Another timely wicket for the visitors and also a spinner gets the breakthrough.
Commentary.Howout: c Akeal Hosein b Nkrumah Bonner

Commentary.Commentary: Darted on the pads, it is flicked to deep square leg for a single.
Musa Ahmad has been hit on his throat while trying to paddle that ball. The physio is out there to examine him and he looks fine to continue now.

A quicker ball, full and around off. Ahmad gets on his knee as he tries to paddle it but mistimes sit and the ball deflects and hits him near his chin. He needs some assistance and the physio is called up.
Outside off, dragged to deep square leg for a single.
Tossed up, outside off. Scott Edwards shuffles across and tucks it to deep square leg. Two fielders converge and both fumble to collect the ball. In the end, two runs are comfortably taken.
Flatter and on off. Scott is a touch late as he drives it to cover. Straight to the man there.
Flighted ball, outside off. Scott Edwards tries to sweep it but misses.
Full toss, outside off. Musa gets low and sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
A loopy ball, around middle and off. Ahmad looks to reverse-sweep it but misses and gets hit on the pads. The replay shows there was gloves on it. A single.
Quicker, flatter and outside off. Ahmad keeps it out.
Both the batters are enjoying sweeping! Fuller and on middle. Ahmad sweeps it behind square on the leg side for a brace.
Tossed up, around off. Scott Edwards mistimes his reverse-sweep to point and takes another quick single.
On middle, swept to deep square leg for a single.
A leggie, full and on off. Scott pushes it to covers and calls for a quick single. The fielder underarms it to the keeper but Ahmad was in.

DRINKS! West Indies have done well to pull this game back. Both the spinners Walsh and Akeal Hosein have bowled well and Netherlands have struggled to find momentum in these middle overs as they have lost three wickets on the way. Scott Edwards is a good player of spin and Netherlands would hope that he along with Musa Ahmad can build a solid partnership here. West Indies, on the other hand, would be looking to take more wickets and restrict Dutch to as low a total as possible.
Too full and on off. Ahmad punches it to mid off.

Walsh serves a googly, full and outside off. Ahmad defends in the wrong line and gets beaten on the outside edge. Hope whips the bails off in a flash and appeals straightaway. UltraEdge shows no bat there. The replay shows Ahmad had his foot out of the line but just in when the bails were taken off. Musa survives.
Flatter and just outside off. Edwards dabs it with soft hands to short third man for a single.
Tossed up, quicker through the air and outside off. Edwards misses his sweep again.
Scott Edwards again tries to sweep it but this is a flighted full toss and Scott mistimes it on the off side.
FOUR! Another boundary! Scott Edwards is trying to change the gears now. This is full and wide outside off. Edwards drags and sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Five wides! A welcome boundary! Walsh pushes it quicker down the leg side. Scott misses his sweep. The keeper tries to stop it but the ball goes through him and races into the fine leg fence.
Tossed up on off. Scott Edwards reverse-paddles it to short third man for a single.
On middle and leg and this is tad fuller. Scott Edwards works it towards the mid-wicket region with soft hands for a couple.
Short and wide outside off. Scott Edwards cuts it to sweeper cover for a couple.
Dragged down on off. Musa Ahmad goes back and pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
On the shorter side and around off. Musa Ahmad cuts it to backward point.

Almost a wicket off the first ball! Short and wide outside off. It keeps a bit low and Scott Edwards who tries to cut it gets an inside edge off his blade. The ball goes past stumps towards short fine leg for a single.
Fuller on middle. Scott Edwards works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Darted on the pads. Musa Ahmad works it towards short fine leg for a single.
Loopy delivery again on off. Musa Ahmad blocks it out.
Tossed up, around off. Musa Ahmad drives it straight to the cover fielder.

Walsh pushes it quicker and outside off. It is a googly and Musa Ahmad looks to defend it off the front foot. He gets beaten off the outside edge and the keeper collects the ball quickly and whips the bails off. There is an appeal for the stumping and the leg umpire takes it upstairs. The replays though show that the batter's back leg is well inside the crease and he is safe.
Tossed up on off. Scott Edwards drives it to covers for a single.
Musa Ahmad walks out to the middle.

OUT! BOWLED! Netherlands are losing the plot here, both these Windies spinners are all over them and Bas de Leede crumbles under pressure. This is a flighted delivery on off. Bas de Leede steps down the track but fails to reach the pitch of the ball. He looks to work it towards the leg side but misses. The ball goes between his bat and pads and shatters the stumps. West Indies are back in this game!
A flatter one on off. Bas de Leede blocks it off the front foot.
Darted on middle. Bas de Leede works it towards mid-wicket.
Nice loopy delivery on off. Bas de Leede skips down the track and defends it but not convincingly.

Tossed up on off. Scott Edwards skips down the track and looks to work it towards the leg side. He closes the face of his blade early and the ball goes off the leading edge towards covers for a single.
Slower in the air and around off. Scott Edwards pushes it square off the wicket on the off side.
Tossed up on off. Bas de Leede defends it off the front foot.
This time a googly and outside off. Bas de Leede leaves it and the ball turns in sharply but away from the off pole.
A flatter delivery on off. Bas de Leede blocks it out.
Loopy delivery on off. Bas de Leede drives it but Pooran at short extra cover does well to stop it.
Slower in the air on middle. Bas de Leede nudges it towards mid-wicket.
Darted on middle and it is very full. Scott Edwards works it towards the leg side and takes a single.
Fuller and quicker on off. Bas de Leede blocks it off the front foot.
A flatter one on middle. Bas de Leede works it towards the leg side.
Bas de Leede is the new man in.

OUT! CHOPPED ON! Here is the big breakthrough and Akeal Hosein provides it. The set-batter, Max O'Dowd departs now! The run-scoring has dropped in the last few overs and the pressure was building a bit on these two batters. Akeal Hosein keeps it little short and around off. Max O'Dowd goes back to punch it away but the ball stays a tad low and it catches the inside edge of Max O'Dowd's blade. It goes onto to hit the stumps and Max O'Dowd is gutted as he gets out just after his fifty.
A flatter delivery on off and shorter in length. Max O'Dowd punches it to covers.
Pushed quicker on off. Edwards pushes it to long off for a single.
A flatter delivery on middle. Scott Edwards works it to mid-wicket.
Akeal Hosein is back on.
Full and around off. O'Dowd shuffles across and blocks it.
Too full and on off, pushed to long off for an easy single.
Floated ball, around off. Scott Edwards reverse sweeps it but straight to short third man.
Tossed up, around off, driven through covers for a single.
A flighted full toss, on off, drilled down to long on for a single.
Flatter, outside off, stays low. Scott cuts it to cover.
A low full toss on off, it is hit to mid off for a single.

Fifty for Max O'Dowd! He has given his team the perfect start and will now aim for a triple-digit score. Length ball, around off. O'Dowd plays with soft hands to mid-wicket and scampers across for a quick single. He raises his bat and takes the applause from the home crowd,
Follows it with a steep bouncer, around leg. O'Dowd lets it through.
On a length and on middle. Edwards stays back and nudges it in front of square on the leg side for a single.
Bangs a bouncer at 137 clicks and Scott sits under it.
Length ball, outside off. Scott Edwards keeps it out on the off side.
Pushes it around off. O'Dowd drives it hard but straight to the cover fielder. West Indies have done well to slow things down after the wicket.
Good running! Tossed up, around off. O'Dowd drives it through point and comes back for the second with a good sprint.
Another quick single as Scott works it through point for a single.
A single after eight dot balls. Length ball, around off. O'Dowd plays it to sweeper cover for a single.
A loopy ball, around off. O'Dowd leans and knocks it to cover.
Flatter and around off. O'Dowd dabs it to backward point.
Around off, pushed to covers.
Short of a length, outside off. Scott Edwards leaves it alone.
Length ball, this one skids through, around off. Scott taps it to covers.
Drags his length ball, around off. Scott Edwards ducks under it.
Outside off, on a length. Scott Edwards plays it to short third man.
A ripper! A length ball, around off, nips back in. Scott Edwards is hurried as he tucks it away to square leg.
Alzarri Joseph is back on. Three overs for 15 runs so far.
Tossed up, on off. Edwards leans and knocks it to cover for a quick single. Superb start by Hayden, a wicket and five runs off it.
Too full and it is drilled down to long on for one more.
Fuller and on middle, pushed through covers for a single.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Finally, West Indies get the breakthrough! A soft dismissal this one, Singh will be disappointed with this shot and he misses out yet again after coming close to his fifty! Walsh flights this one, fuller and around middle. Singh pushes it straight back to Walsh who holds onto it. West Indies finally have the opening, Can they build on this?
Scott Edwards walks in at number 3.
Wide! Tries the googly but ends up spilling it down the leg side. Singh misses his flick.
Tossed up, on middle. Singh blocks it out.
Starts by sliding one on the pads, it is flicked to deep square leg for a single. 100 up for Netherlands.
Hayden Walsh is into the attack.
A slower fullish delivery, outside off. Singh looks to push it away but gets beaten.
FOUR! Stylish again from Singh! Mayers angles it on middle and leg from 'round the wicket. The length is also a bit short and Singh just whips it towards deep backward square leg for a boundary.
Good delivery! A yorker on off by Mayers. Singh gets his bat down in time and blocks it.
Shorter in length and outside off. Max O'Dowd throws his bat at this one. He gets a thick outside edge and the ball goes off the bounce towards the third man. A single taken.
Pulls his length back, on off. Max O'Dowd defends it calmly.
Overpitched delivery on off. Max O'Dowd drives it towards covers.
Pitching on off and turning into the batter. Singh blocks it out.
On the shorter side on off. Max O'Dowd punches it to covers for a single.
SIX! Max O'Dowd takes full advantage of this Free Hit! On middle and full. Max O'Dowd gets low and slog-sweeps it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.

NO BALL! Hosein bowls it bit short on middle. Singh shuffles across and pulls it to deep backward square leg. The batters run three and the umpires calls it a no ball as well as Akeal Hosein oversteps. There is more drama as the the umpires check for a short run. But finds that everything is good enough in that regard and now we have a Free Hit coming up.
This is fuller on off. Max O'Dowd drives it to long off for a single.
It is flat and quicker on off. Max O'Dowd blocks it out.
Angling on the pads. Singh tucks it to deep square leg for a single.
Lands on a length, on off. Max O'Dowd blocks it out.
On the shorter side again, around off. Max O'Dowd opens the face of his blade and looks to guide it through the backward point region but fails to find the gap.
Back of a length, around off. Max O'Dowd dabs it towards point.
A fullish delivery on off. Singh drives it to covers for a single.
FOUR! Good shot and good intent from Singh! A length delivery on off. Singh dances down the track and lofts it towards the long on region as the ball rolls over the ropes.
Short and wide outside off. Max O'Dowd cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Kyle Mayers is back into the attack.
A flatter one on middle. Singh blocks it out.
On the shorter side on middle. Singh tucks it towards the leg side.

Ohh...lovely delivery! This is pitched around off and turns into Singh sharply. He is beaten all ends up as looks to drive it. The ball goes just over the stumps and even the keeper fails to collect it cleanly.
Turning into middle from off. Singh works it towards the leg side.
Fuller on off. Max O'Dowd leans forward and drives it to long off for a single.
Flatter and slightly shorter on off. Max O'Dowd punches it to covers.

Drinks! Netherlands are off to a superb start and they are making full use of the survival given to them. West Indies have been good with the ball but really disappointing in the field. They should have got these two inside the 5th over but the chance went begging one after the other. They will hope to take their chances now.
Back of a length, around off. Singh makes a bit of room and guides it to point this time. Just a single from the over.

Lands on a length, on off. Singh first shapes up to pull it but then realises that the ball is not that short and ends up working it towards mid-wicket. Checks his shot at the last moment and does quite well in the end.
Bangs it short, around off. Singh sways away from the line of the ball.
A slower length delivery on middle. Max O'Dowd turns it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Lands on a length, around off. Max O'Dowd guides it towards short third man.
Full delivery on off. Max O'Dowd drives it to mid off.
Flatter and on middle. O'Dowd tucks it to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Great shot! Tossed up, slanting on middle. O'Dowd goes inside-out and hits it to perfection over extra-cover for a boundary.
A flatter delivery on middle. Max O'Dowd defends it towards the leg side.
Around off. Singh drives it down to long off for a single.
Full again, outside off. Singh smashes it but straight to covers.
Full and on off, pushed back to the bowler.

Dropped! Max O'Dowd gets another life! Short of a length, outside off. O'Dowd gets on his toes as he tries to play at third man but it goes off the outside edge and Kyle Mayers at gully dives to his right but fails to take it. Was a regulation catch but West Indies are below-par on the field. Max O'Dowd was walking off straight after hitting it but comes back after seeing the catch being put down.
Short one, around off. O'Dowd hooks it away to deep square leg for a brace.
Fuller ball on off, O'Dowd drives it but straight to the man at mid off.
On the pads, fuller, it is flicked uppishly to deep square leg for a single.
Length ball, outside off. O'Dowd punches it square on the off side for a single.
A sharp bouncer around off. O'Dowd looks to pull but misses.
An arm ball, around middle. Singh turns it to mid-wicket.
On middle. Blocked back to the bowler.
Wide! Hosein slants it on the leg side. Singh misses his flick and the keeper is quick to whip the bails off. There is an appeal from Akeal for caught behind but not given.
Darted on the pads, tucked to square leg.
Around off, eased down to long off for a single.
Hosein is getting some turn on offer! Flighted nicely, around off, it spins away sharply. Max makes room to push it away but misses.
This one lands on leg and turns away. O'Dowd defends off the outer half of the bat to covers.
Length ball, on off. Singh drops it to covers.
Change of ball! The players can't find the ball from the bushes!
SIX! What a shot! On a length and on the pads. Vikramjit Singh hangs back and flicks it all the way over deep square leg for a biggie. Made his wrists do all the work.
Wide! This is down the leg side. Singh misses his whip.
Bangs a short one, on off. O'Dowd rides the pull and hits it to deep square leg for a single.
Good bowling from Anderson Phillip! Serves it short and slanting around off. O'Dowd looks to pull but gets cramped and pulls his bat out at the last minute.
Fuller and on the pads. Singh flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball, outside off. O'Dowd opens the face of the bat and steers it to third man for a single.
Darted on the pads. Singh tucks it to mid-wicket. Tidy start from Akeal Hosein.
Plays with the spin, this is on the pads, it is hit straight to mid-wicket.
Too full and on off. O'Dowd goes inside-out through covers for a single.
Tossed up, on middle, it is played back to the bowler.
Tossed up, on off. Singh knocks it through covers for a single. 50 up for Netherlands!
Flatter and around off. Singh blocks it out on the off side.
End of Powerplay1! Now, 4 fielders can be allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over! Akeal Hosein comes onto bowl now.
On the shorter side and around off. Max O'Dowd rides the bounce and punches it square off the wicket on the off side.
On a length, on off. Max O'Dowd defends it towards the off side.

Anderson Phillip bowls it short and on middle. Max O'Dowd goes for the pull shot but gets a top edge. The ball goes in the air and falls in the vacant region at deep backward square leg. Two runs taken.
On the shorter side again, on off. Max O'Dowd defends it off the back foot.
Back of a length, around off. Max O'Dowd punches it through covers. The fielder from the ring runs behind it to cut it off as the batters run two in the meanwhile.
On a length, on off. Max O'Dowd blocks it out.
FOUR! Cracking shot! Short and wide outside off. Singh slaps it through covers for a boundary as it races away towards the fence.
Drifting on the pads. Singh clips it but straight to the short fine leg fielder. Either side of that fielder and it would have given Singh a boundary.
Fullish delivery on middle. Max O'Dowd works it to square leg for a single.
FOUR! Lovely shot! This is full on off. Max O'Dowd skips down the track and drives it straight down the ground for a boundary.
Lands on a length, on off. Max O'Dowd blocks it out.
Back of a length and angling into middle from 'round the wicket. Singh pulls it towards deep mid-wicket and takes three runs. Good running!
Goes a bit full on off at 129 kph. Max O'Dowd pushes it off the front foot to mid off. Sedate start from the Netherlands openers but the good thing is that they have not lost a wicket so far.
Lands on a length, on middle at 132 kph. Max O'Dowd defends it calmly towards the leg side.
Back of a length, on off. Singh pulls it wide of mid on for a single.
On a length, on middle. Singh blocks it towards the leg side.
Well bowled! Lands on a good length and it is around off. The ball seams away from the batter and Singh is beaten off the outside edge as he looks to defend.
Anderson Phillip drifts on the pads straightaway. Max O'Dowd flicks it to fine leg for a single.
First bowling change of the innings. Anderson Phillip is into the attack.
Mayers ends the over with a short ball on off. Max O'Dowd pulls it to deep square leg for just a single this time.
FOUR! Signs of aggression from Max O'Dowd! On a length, on middle. Max O'Dowd just whips it towards deep square leg and gets a boundary.
On a length, on off. Max O'Dowd with a solid block off the front foot.
Tight run! A full delivery on middle. Singh drives it to mid on and sets off for a single. Pooran there has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Single in the end.
Lands on a length, on off. Max O'Dowd defends it off the inside half of his blade and a single is taken as the ball rolls towards right of square leg.
Mayers with a fullish length on off. Max O'Dowd drives it to mid on.
A fullish length and outside off. Singh throws his bat at this one without much foot movement but fails to connect.
An effort delivery again, shorter in length and around off. Singh watches it till the end and sways away from the line of the ball.
Overpitched on middle. Singh drives it to mid on.
Goes a bit full on off. Singh heaves it across the line and comes back for the second run as the ball travels towards the deep mid-wicket region.
WIDE! Third wide of the over, struggling with his radar in this over, Joseph. Back of a length and around leg. Singh looks to pull but misses as the ball goes back to the keeper.
FOUR! Stand and deliver stuff! A fullish length, on off. Singh drives it crisply left of mid off as he is too wide and the ball races away towards the fence.
WIDE! Another wayward delivery by Jospeh. He keeps it short of length and sprays this down the leg side again. Singh looks to flick it away but misses.
WIDE! On the shorter side again and this time down the leg side. Singh looks to pull but misses.
Joseph bangs it short on middle. Singh ducks under it.

Dropped! Now, Vikramjit Singh gets a life! West Indies have not worked on the fielding and it looks the same as we saw in the first match. A length ball from 'round the wicket and around off. Singh looks to push with hard hands but gets a thick outside edge. Nkrumah Bonner at third slip dives low to his right but fails to catch it. Netherlands running on luck at the moment.
Length ball, just outside off. Singh gets a straight bat down as he defends it out.
Around off, fuller length and Singh pushes it to extra cover.
Touch fuller and around off. Singh pushes it to mid off.
On a length and on off. Defended out.

Dropped! A chance goes begging! Fuller and on middle. O'Dowd steps forward as he tries to loft it over mid on but fails to clear the infield. Alzarri Joseph there, leaps and gets a hand to it but fails to collect it. A single taken.
Short in length and outside off. Singh looks to push but gets beaten again.
Short in length and on off, Singh strokes it to cover.
FOUR! FIrst boundary off the innings! Short in length and on middle. Singh makes room and ramps it over the slip cordon for a boundary. Really good shot.
Length ball, outside off. O'Dowd plays it down to third man for a single.
Two leg byes! Angles it on the pads. O'Dowd clips it off the pads and behind square on the leg side for a couple.
Outside off. Left alone.
Uppish but safe! A length ball, outside off, nipping away. Singh looks to drive but slices it to backward point.
Outside off again, this one nips away slightly. Singh plays at it but only to get beaten on the outside edge.
Perfect line and length from Mayers! Short in length and outside off. Singh has a poke at it but fails to connect.
Pitched up, around off, Singh works it to point. No run there.
Length ball, on the pads. O'Dowd tucks it behind square on the leg side for a single.
On a length and outside off, it is pushed to covers.
Just a single from the over! Good start from Joseph! On middle, it is flicked past mid-wicket and O'Dowd is off the mark with a single.
Right on the money! Attempts a yorker, on middle. O'Dowd digs it out to mid on.
Good pace here! This one is at 140 clicks, on a length and on middle. O'Dowd keeps it out.
Keeps it outside off, on a length. O'Dowd lets it through to the keeper.
Goes touch short now, outside off. O'Dowd shoulders arms.
Joseph starts with a ripper! A length ball, outside off, nips away a touch. Max O'Dowd looks to drive but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Alzarri Joseph to share the new ball with Kyle Mayers.
Short of a length and too outside off. Singh is happy to let it through. 4 runs to start the innings.
Leg bye! Sharp swing there! A length ball, slanting on the pads. O'Dowd misses his flick and it goes to square leg off the pads. A leg bye is taken.
Touch fuller and outside off. O'Dowd knocks it to cover.

Angles a length ball down the leg side. O'Dowd misses his flick and it goes off the thigh pads to the keeper. A stifled appeal follows but mostly from the players around the off side and not the bowler.
On a length and on off. O'Dowd pushes it straight to mid off.
Three runs! Netherlands are underway! A length ball from 'round the wicket and angling onto the pads. Singh flicks it past mid-wicket and the batters take three runs.

We are all set to begin! West Indies players are out there in the middle. Vikramjit Singh and Max O'Dowd are the openers for Netherlands. The players are taking knee in support of the Black Lives Matter movement. Kyle Mayers to start with the ball for West Indies. Here we go...

The captain of West Indies, Nicholas Pooran says they would've bat first as he feels the pitch might get slower later in the game. Says he is impressed with Brandon King and the openers as well. Tells the core is to bat throughout the innings. Informs they are playing the same team.

Pieter Seelaar, the skipper of Netherlands, says that they will bat first and adds that the pitch looks good to bat on. Tells that they played well in the first game but they need to be better in this game. Mentions that they need to be tighter with the bat and bat well against the spin. Informs that they have one change in their side.

PITCH REPORT - Peter Borren says that the pitch is the same that was used for the first ODI and it is very good for batting. Tells that it might slow down a bit and spinners might come into play. Mentions that the captain that wins the toss should bat first.

West Indies (Unchanged playing XI) - Nicholas Pooran (C), Shai Hope (WK), Nkrumah Bonner, Shamarh Brooks, Keacy Carty, Akeal Hosein, Alzarri Joseph, Brandon King, Kyle Mayers, Anderson Phillip, Hayden Walsh.

Netherlands (Playing XI) - Max O'Dowd, Vikramjit Singh, Musa Ahmad, Scott Edwards (WK), Bas de Leede, Pieter Seelaar (C), Teja Nidamanuru, Logan van Beek, Aryan Dutt, Ryan Klein, Shariz Ahmad (In for Vivian Kingma).
TOSS - Netherlands have won the toss and they will BAT first!

West Indies, on the other hand, delivered a clinical performance in the first game. Akeal Hosein was the standout performer with the ball while seamers also did their job decently. Shai Hope was the star with the bat and Windies will be overall very happy with how they went about their chase. Nkrumah Bonner and Nicholas Pooran missed out in the last game with the bat but expect both of them to be at the top of their game today. Can Dutch fight back and level the series here? Or will Nicholas Pooran and his young team seal the series in this second ODI? Let's find out. Also, the forecast is cloudy for the day but we hope that the rain god stays away from the action. Toss and team sheets in a while.

This is an exciting home summer for the Dutch and they would like to make a statement with a strong performance on their home turf. They had their moments in the first game both with the bat and ball but they need more players to step up and need someone to deliver a big performance if they want to stay alive in this series. Both of their openers got starts in the first game but failed to carry on and that is one thing they need to work on as a batting group.

Hello and a warm welcome to the second ODI of this three-match ODI series between West Indies and Netherlands. Windies have started the tour with a convincing win in the first ODI and would be looking to seal the series with another strong performance. The hosts, Netherlands, on the other hand, need a win to stay alive in this series and it will be interesting to see how things pan out between two sides desperately looking to grab some World Cup Super League points.
